row_evidence.finding: the published Knowledge Base contract lists CRUD, crawler, crawler status, training, trained-url and FAQ operations; it publishes no file-source upload operation
row_evidence.consequence: WF30 refuses with file_upload_contract_unresolved before any network call and never invents a path, Version, media type or body field

transport_rules: the transport constructs one valid multipart boundary and body; the caller never sets a boundary
Authorization is a request header only; it never becomes a form field and never travels to an asset host
the tenant credential is bound to the operation row's tenant for this location
the transport hashes the actual bytes and records a redacted request fingerprint
upload acceptance is not ingestion, training or retrieval readiness
a timeout or reset after submission is unknown_outcome and is reconciled by provider file/job id before any retry
a missing media type or an unsupported file is refused before transport, never disguised as JSON or base64

retained_fields: provider file id when the body returns fileId/id/_id
